1 · moved to NX-OS
NX-LEAF-01 learns it locally and advertises MM sequence 1: higher than anything seen, so every leaf prefers it. LEAF-5 withdraws in 0.27 s

div.div: Measured (pings every 100 ms from SERVER-6 on Cumulus and CLIENT-16 on NX-OS): 900 ms lost on the move to NX-OS, 700 ms on the move back, identical from both fabrics.

div.div: Flapping: eight moves in 40 s and both vendors flag a duplicate host (Cumulus default: 5 moves in 180 s). A loop or two hosts sharing a MAC look exactly like this. Detection raises the alarm; only freezing (off by default on Cumulus) stops the churn.
